summary: Seabridge Gold filed a Form 6-K (management information circular) providing details on the proposed spin-out of its 100% interest in the Courageous Lake gold project into a new entity, Valor Gold Corp, via a plan of arrangement. Under the arrangement, Seabridge will subscribe for 700,000 Valor Shares and distribute all Valor Shares to Seabridge shareholders. A special shareholder meeting is scheduled for May 22, 2026, to approve the transaction. The board recommends the spin-out, citing under-valuation of Courageous Lake relative to the KSM project. The circular filed on SEDAR+ and EDGAR provides full terms. Watch for shareholder vote outcome and Valor's listing debut.
